# antigravity-priority v1.3.3

## 更新内容 / Release Notes

### 中文

**Antigravity Priority v1.3.3 聚焦 5 小时预热的时间打散与配额记账真实性：所有凭证共享一条持久化全局预热车道，概览卡片新增三态预热图标，预热与配额读取统一到消费端接口，并以结构化冷却截止时间区分健康隔离与额度耗尽。**

#### ♨️ 全局预热车道与卡片级覆盖
- **全局错峰车道**：所有凭证共享一条持久化预热车道，跨凭证随机间隔 60–120 分钟、同凭证不同分组 30–60 分钟，彻底打散 5h 刷新时间点；车道槽位在探测前预留并落盘，重启、慢响应或扫描间隔都不会让两个分组挤进同一窗口。
- **卡片三态预热图标**：概览卡片顶部新增 ♨️ 图标，默认跟随对应分组（Gemini / Argon 共用 Gemini 开关，Claude & GPT 独立）的全局开关；点击后局部状态优先，点击结果与全局状态一致时自动清除局部状态并恢复跟随；局部开启会同时清除该凭证的 4h30m 防抖，使其可立即进入下一个预热槽位。
- **Free 账号隔离**：Free 账号不渲染预热图标，也不参与任何预热探测或生成。
- **即时交互反馈**：点击图标立即切换点亮状态并显示待处理脉冲动画，请求失败时回滚图标并提示错误。
- **预热资格收紧**：5h 短窗满额但 7d 周额度已耗尽时不再预热；重置边界的证据刷新拥有独立探测预算，预热请求本身失败不再消耗重试预算或进入退避。
- **配置链路完整**：局部覆盖状态随动态配置持久化，配置中心保存不会丢失；概览、配置中心、帮助页文案同步说明新的间隔规则与图标行为。

#### 🎯 消费端流量记账真实性
- **统一消费端入口**：配额摘要与预热生成统一发送到 Antigravity 消费端主机，移除 production / sandbox 多主机扇出与逐模型列表拼接，响应缺失的分组如实上报为探测失败，不再把无关来源的配额导入快照。
- **真实流量形态**：预热请求补齐消费端身份字段（客户端标识、请求类型、请求 ID、会话 ID），确保消耗真实进入实测配额账本；Gemini 预热改为长回答并要求不少于 600 token 的输出（输出上限 2048），Claude / GPT 保持短提示；健康探测仍使用短提示，不为验证连通性支付长回答成本。

#### 🛡️ 冷却判定与调度一致性
- **结构化冷却判定**：调度计划携带冷却截止时间并透传至快照，路由看板与诊断页据此区分健康隔离与额度耗尽；`health probe HTTP 404`、`health probe transport error` 等不含 “cooldown” 字样的原因不再被误标为耗尽，冷却结束或探测成功后自动恢复。

#### 🎨 界面修复
- **下拉菜单宽度**：自定义下拉菜单在触发按钮宽度内展开并支持内部滚动，不再越界撑破布局。

#### ⚙️ 工程与 CI
- **构建时限**：FreeBSD 虚拟机构建增加超时上限，避免长期占用 runner。
- **测试隔离**：运行时可关闭后台 worker，手动扫描用例不再与后台预热/限流协程竞争；新增预热图标交互与结构化冷却判定的渲染用例。

### English

**Antigravity Priority v1.3.3 focuses on spreading 5-hour warm-ups apart and on quota accounting truth: every credential shares one persisted global warm-up lane, overview cards gain a tri-state warm-up icon, quota reads and warm-ups converge on the consumer surface, and structured cooldown deadlines separate health isolation from quota depletion.**

#### ♨️ Global Warm-Up Lane & Card-Level Overrides
- **Global Staggering Lane**: All credentials share one persisted warm-up lane with randomized spacing — 60–120 minutes across credentials and 30–60 minutes between pools of the same credential — so 5h refresh points never coincide. The lane slot is reserved and persisted before the probe, so a restart, a slow upstream, or the sweep interval can never squeeze two pools into the same window.
- **Tri-State Card Icon**: Overview cards gain a ♨️ icon that follows the global toggle of its pool (Gemini / Argon share the Gemini switch, Claude & GPT is independent). A click makes the local state win; a click that matches the global state clears the override and restores follow mode. Turning a credential on clears its 4h30m debounce so it can take the next lane slot immediately.
- **Free Plan Isolation**: Free accounts never render the icon and never take part in warm-up probes or generations.
- **Immediate Feedback**: The icon flips optimistically with a pending pulse and rolls back with an error toast if the request fails.
- **Tighter Eligibility**: A full 5h window no longer warms up when the 7d pool is exhausted; reset-boundary evidence refreshes carry their own probe budget, and warm-up failures keep no retry budget or backoff state.
- **Complete Config Path**: Local overrides persist with the dynamic config and survive config-center saves; the overview, config center, and help page all describe the new spacing rules and icon behavior.

#### 🎯 Consumer-Surface Accounting
- **Single Consumer Surface**: Quota summaries and warm-up generations now go only to the Antigravity consumer host. The production / sandbox fan-out and per-model list stitching are removed; groups missing from the response are reported as probe failures instead of importing quota data from an unrelated source.
- **Real Traffic Shape**: Warm-up requests carry the consumer identity fields (client identity, request type, request ID, session ID) so spent tokens reach the measured quota ledger. Gemini warm-ups request a long answer of at least 600 tokens with a 2048-token output budget, Claude / GPT keep the short prompt, and health probes stay on the short prompt instead of paying for a full completion.

#### 🛡️ Cooldown Classification & Scheduling Consistency
- **Structured Cooldown Deadlines**: Plans carry the cooldown deadline through to the snapshot, and the routing board and diagnostics classify cooldown from it. Reasons without the word “cooldown” — such as `health probe HTTP 404` or `health probe transport error` — are no longer mislabeled as depletion, and the pool recovers once the cooldown clears or a probe succeeds.

#### 🎨 UI Fixes
- **Select Menu Width**: Custom select menus stay inside their trigger width with internal scrolling instead of overflowing the layout.

#### ⚙️ Engineering & CI
- **Build Time Limit**: The FreeBSD VM build gains a timeout so it cannot occupy a runner indefinitely.
- **Test Isolation**: Background workers can be disabled at the runtime, so manual sweep tests no longer race with the warm-up and rate-limit goroutines; new renderer coverage exercises the warm-up icon interaction and structured cooldown classification.
